card.name: Space before IV diluent solution names
card.fires_on: The space or linking word ("of", "or", "with") right before an IV diluent such as 0.9% sodium chloride or 5% dextrose, in dilution and compatible-solution instructions.

modes.label: Space before percent solution
modes.description: A blank space after "of", "with" or "or" just before a percentage like 0.9% or 5%.
